title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-samira-patel-aaron-li-2026-08-10.json
content:
Meeting: 1:1 w/ Aaron Li (AE)
Date/Time: 2026-08-10, 10:00am PT (30m)
Location: Zoom / #cs-ae-sync thread
Purpose: quick sync on key accounts and alignment on Q3 close activities + handoffs for escalations. 30m is tight so keep to top 3 account asks.

Top objectives for this 1:1
- Align on Redwood Enterprise (RE) renewal path and next steps for technical exec call.
- Get AE context on upsell priorities for Q3 and any cross-sell motion we should surface.
- Confirm who is owning immediate action items for NodeAI POC blocker (infra quota) and timeline.

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick wins / highlights (3-4m)
   - RE: success metrics from last demo -> engagement spike on inference costs doc ; cost savings calc looked good for infra team.
   - NodeAI: demo scheduled, but POC blocked by GPU quota.
2) Account deep dive: Redwood Enterprise (10m)
   - Current state: renewal target $420k ARR, renewal date 2026-09-15. Primary champion: CTO (Priya Rao). Procurement loop: security + finance signoff.
   - Risks: SSO integration delayed (SP-1234), legal review pushed to 8/20. Exec support needed to keep timeline.
   - Asks for Aaron: intro to Priya's finance contact (if you have a direct email) and help secure 15m exec Q&A with CTO week of 8/16.
   - My asks: prepare a one-pager summary of cost delta w/ dedicated vs hosted (I can draft, need your quick review).
3) NodeAI POC (8m)
   - Problem: quota + IAM on their VPC blocked model ingest step. Ticket JIRA-CS-2984 assigned to infra-eng but needs urgent priority.
   - Proposed workaround: temporary dedicated instance (low-latency) under trial credits - ask Aaron to sign off with sales credit approval.
   - Timeline: want POC live by 8/18 to hit project milestones.
4) Q3 internal plays & handoffs (5m)
   - Identify top upsell targets: Redwood Enterprise, ScaleCommerce, DataLens. Confirm AE prioritized list.
   - Ask Aaron to share any upcoming exec briefings where CS presence would help (we can co-present value/cost model).
5) Career / feedback / 1:1 housekeeping (2m)
   - Quick pulse on my bandwidth (will be OOO 8/24-8/28) and support needed while OOO.

Notes to self (things to say / callouts)
- Emphasize: customer ROI from caching + batching changes we implemented - have numbers ready (tokens/sec improvement, estimated cost savings).
- For RE exec call, prep 2 slides: 1) risk / mitigation plan for SSO/legal, 2) expected cost trajectory with dedicated pool + savings timeline.
- Use \"we own this\" tone for NodeAI quota ask to show urgency.
- Ask Aaron if any competitive intel (other vendors offering easier SSO) that we should address proactively.

Account health snapshot (quick bullets)
- Redwood Enterprise: Health = amber. NPS internal contact: 7/10. Engagement: high in infra team, low uptime on SRE pilot. Renewal target locked but legal + SSO risk.
- NodeAI: Health = red for POC. Exec sponsor engaged but engineering blocked.

Action items (post-meeting) - assign owners & ETA
- Samira: Draft RE one-pager (cost comparison dedicated vs hosted) + 2-slide exec brief by 8/12. (owner: Samira)
- Aaron: Introduce finance contact for RE and secure 15m exec Q&A week of 8/16 (owner: Aaron)
- Aaron/Samira: Approve temporary dedicated instance credits for NodeAI POC and confirm infra ticket priority (JIRA-CS-2984) by 8/12. (owner: Aaron primary, Samira follow-up)
- Samira: Schedule technical call with NodeAI infra + our infra-eng (cc: eng-oncall) for 8/13 to unblock IAM/quotas. (owner: Samira)
- Samira: Update playbook doc for SSO/legal common blockers and link to CONFLUENCE-RTM-4567 by 8/14. (owner: Samira)

Follow-up notes (what I want to track)
- Track legal review progress (expected 8/20) + escalation if delayed past 8/18.
- Confirm POC live date and report daily status until 8/20.

Personal development / talking points with Aaron
- Ask for 1 concrete example of how I can be more proactive in escalations (I want to improve faster).
- Ask for feedback on my stakeholder slides (clear? technical enough?).

Misc: quick links / refs
- SSO integration spec: CONFLUENCE-RTM-4567
- NodeAI POC ticket: JIRA-CS-2984
- Infra PR for temporary quota handling: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/312

Draft email templates to use after meeting (short):
- To RE finance contact: "Hi <name>, Aaron suggested I reach out re: cost model for Redwood Enterprise renewal. Attached one-pager + brief ask for 15m exec Q&A week of Aug 16. Are you available?"
- To NodeAI infra: "Hi team, we're lined up to get your POC live - want to confirm availability for 30m on 8/13 to unblock quotas. Please confirm owner."

TODO (notes to self)
- Print cost numbers into slide (tokens saved, estimated monthly saving)
- Pull last demo recording timecodes (for exec call highlights)
- Prep 2-3 questions to ask CTO on value props (short, exec-level)

End of doc.
